capability: The six-state Open3D npa.workflow executed through the standard SkyPilot runtime
why_this_matters: This is the one gate LANE.md still required and that I had recorded as an external blocker. It was not one: root's isolated-config-dir finding cleared the controller-adoption guard, and the remaining refusals were a sequence of real preflight checks that each had a supported answer.
image_note: Built from the source commit above and delivered privately by digest. Never published.

runtime.path: npa workbench workflow submit, controller-backend kubernetes, isolated state root
runtime.controller: a lane-owned jobs controller created by the isolated state root; the historical shared controller was not bound, rebound, renamed or cleaned up
runtime.managed_job: reconciled managed job 1 on that controller
runtime.cluster_adoption: npa cluster kubeconfig --cluster-name ... --project ... --context ..., the supported command; it fetched the real cluster id and wrote the record under a lane-owned NPA_CONFIG_DIR. cluster.json was not hand-edited and provision-if-absent was not run.
runtime.accelerator: none requested at any stage; Open3D registration and reconstruction have no CUDA path

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: Cleared by the isolated state root, which by design does not consult shared controller ownership. This is the guard I had wrongly recorded as an absolute blocker.

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.guard: endpoint: storage endpoint must match the selected project region
preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: The <other-project> project record declares <region-a> while its own cluster API and storage endpoint are both <region-a>. Answered with a lane-owned NPA_CONFIG_DIR copy carrying the corrected region. The shared config was not modified and still reads <region-a>; someone should decide whether that record is simply wrong.

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.guard: region: explicit region disagrees with the selected project
preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: Refused --region as an override, correctly. Superseded by the lane-owned config above.

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.guard: scope: provider project identity is unavailable or mismatched
preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: Correct and not bypassable. The executing service account lives in one project and the originally selected cluster in another, where IAM denies even mk8scluster.list. Answered by moving to a cluster inside the service account's own project rather than by weakening anything.

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.guard: storage_owner: output bucket is not proven to belong to the selected project
preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: Answered with a bucket owned by the selected project.

preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.guard: storage_mount: the executing SkyPilot home requires a complete static nebius AWS profile matching selected storage credentials
preflight_guards_encountered_and_how_eac.answer: NOT answered. This fires only for the --durable-s3 nebius:// mount. The shared ~/.aws [nebius] profile currently carries another project's keys and was written hours earlier while other lanes were running, so overwriting it would likely break a concurrent lane. The run therefore proceeded WITHOUT --durable-s3.

what_this_run_does_not_prove.durable_s3_resume: The run was submitted without --durable-s3, so durable-mount resume is not exercised here. Clearing that needs the shared AWS profile to match the selected project's storage credentials, which is a coordination question, not a code one.
what_this_run_does_not_prove.rerun_ui: Artifacts and camera geometry are verified. No screenshot of the Rerun web viewer was captured, so no viewer-UI claim rests on this run.
what_this_run_does_not_prove.gpu: Nothing GPU was proven and nothing GPU was requested. This workload is CPU-only by construction.

the_framing_fix_is_exercised_by_this_run.why_it_counts: The image was built from the commit carrying the per-view camera change, so the visualize stage in this run ran the new code. The output proves it rather than the commit asserting it.
the_framing_fix_is_exercised_by_this_run.reading: The audit view sits at 3.7969 while the other three sit between 3.2609 and 3.2736. It pulls back specifically to frame the 8453 unsupported triangles the other views do not draw. Under the shipped code all four shared one distance and that surface fell outside the frame.

independent_verification_of_the_output.rrd_decode: PASSED using the repository's own verify_rerun_recording against the downloaded bytes
